subject: general
question: Hirakud Dam was in news due to the conflict between Odisha and Chhattisgarh over the distribution of water from the ____ river on which the dam has been erected.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahanadi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hirakud Dam** is built on the Mahanadi River.
 
• The dam is located near **Sambalpur in Odisha.**
 
• The conflict between Odisha and Chhattisgarh over the Mahanadi river **water distribution** began in 2016.
 
• **Chhattisgarh’s construction of dams and barrages upstream** has led to concerns in Odisha about reduced water flow downstream.

 [IMAGE: https://lotusarise.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/Mahanadi-River-System-UPSC.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Damodar River also known as the **“Sorrow of Bengal”** due to its flooding history.
 
• Indravati River is a** tributary of the Godavari River**, flowing through Odisha and Chhattisgarh.
 
• Sankh River is a **tributary of the Brahmani River**, originating in Jharkhand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
